svg.title: AuraProj daily change reference for 2026-08-09
svg.desc: Authoritative combat rules and life state, smoke policy, and damage producer inventory.
svg.text: 2026-08-09 - Combat rules, state, and producer inventory
main | commits da4b6e1, 60d68d0, 43f95bd, 679fe3a | manually reconstructed daily mind map
Daily job
Turn identity into an authoritative relationship/life-state contract and inventory every damage producer.
Rules, state components, plan gates, network smoke policy, tests, and the Day 4 producer table were established.
BEFORE
Scattered permission logic
No shared relationship result.
No replicated life-state contract.
Damage producers lacked a canonical inventory.
Network mode expectations and policy
could be read as documentation only.
centralize policy and state
AFTER
One structured combat decision surface
Combat state is Alive, Dying, Dead, or Respawning and is authority-owned.
CombatRules evaluates relationship, target, damage, and receive-damage with reasons.
Missing policy defaults to deny; Civilian and friendly paths stay protected.
Producer inventory names projectile, direct, beam, melee, hitscan, radial, and smoke paths.
Network runners now state Listen/Dedicated requirements and bounded failure behavior.
Important guard
Default-deny applies to missing authority, identity,
policy, targetability, damageability, and non-Alive state.
Interaction remains separate from combat targeting.
Replacement pawns stay Respawning until initialization is complete.
Validation and reading path
Day 3 native suite: 8 tests. Combined Day 1-3: 14 tests.
Day 1 plus Listen/Dedicated Day 2 and Day 3 smoke passed.
Producer inventory became the next day's migration allowlist.
Read Role-Battle-Implementation/Day-03-Combat-Rules.md for the contract.
